options.text: Hi, what brings you here?
Hey, you look like shit.
The courthouse is next door.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I hate my job. Can you help me figure out what to do?"

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: The Fool's about starting fresh — standing at the edge and choosing to jump.
The Fool means you're an idiot for staying in a job you hate this long.
Actually, this card isn't about your job at all — try not to overthink it.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Hmm, I'm not sure if that applies to me."

options.text: It's about being willing to leap before you know exactly where you'll land.
You clearly don't want my help, so why did you even come here?
You're right, let's just ignore the card and talk about something else.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "What if I fail and it all falls apart?"

options.text: That fear's the whole test — the Fool says yes to the unknown instead of playing it safe.
Then you'll have proven everyone right about you.
Failure isn't really a possibility if you don't think about it.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "But I don't even have a real plan for what's next."

options.text: You don't need it all mapped out — the path tends to appear once you take the step.
Then you're not ready, and you should just stay where you are.
A plan doesn't really matter either way.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Everyone at work thinks I'm insane for even considering this."

options.text: That reaction's kind of the point — this is nonconformist, go-against-convention energy.
They're right, you should probably listen to them instead.
What other people think shouldn't factor into this at all.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I feel like an idiot, starting over at my age."

options.text: That's not foolish — it's a beginner's mind, curious instead of guarded and jaded.
You should feel that way, honestly — you waited too long.
Age doesn't come into a tarot reading at all.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: One more thing — the Fool travels light. Taking the leap with a little levity beats carrying every worst case with you.
